title: Uroflowmetry
what: You pass urine into a special toilet or funnel, and a device measures how fast and how much urine comes out.
why: For a weak stream, frequent urges, or a feeling that your bladder is not fully empty. Often for prostate problems.
tell_doctor: Which medicines you take for your prostate or bladder. You do not need to stop them yourself
If you have a catheter or recently had urinary tract surgery
If you have pain or burning when you pass urine now

prepare.title: Full bladder
prepare.text: Come with a strong urge to go. Usually you drink half a liter to 1 liter of water 1 to 2 hours before the test.

prepare.title: Do not go
prepare.text: Do not use the toilet before the test. If it is very hard to hold, tell the staff.

prepare.title: Extra time
prepare.text: Come a little early. If the urge is still weak, you can wait at the clinic and drink some water.

bring: Your bladder diary, if your doctor asked you to keep one
steps: When you have a strong urge, you are taken to a private room
You pass urine into the special toilet or funnel, the way you usually do
The device records the speed and volume by itself
Often, an ultrasound then checks how much urine is left in your bladder
feel: Nothing unpleasant. It is a normal trip to the toilet
It may feel awkward, but you will be alone
after: You can go back to your usual day right away
The result is usually ready right away. The urologist explains it
Sometimes the test is repeated if there was too little urine

faq.q: How much water should I drink before uroflowmetry?
faq.a: Usually half a liter to 1 liter over 1 to 2 hours. The main thing is to come with a strong urge and not use the toilet before the test.

faq.q: Why is the test sometimes repeated?
faq.a: If there was too little urine or you were nervous, the result may be inaccurate. Then it is repeated.

reminders.text: Uroflowmetry soon. Drink half a liter to 1 liter of water and do not use the toilet before the test.
